summary.text: Tony Spears is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
His campaign website describes him as the former president of the Harnett County NAACP who has served multiple terms as chair of the Harnett County Board of Elections.

paragraphs.text: Spears's campaign website says his candidacy is focused on quality education, teacher pay and community development in Harnett County.

Its platform lists school funding and teacher pay increases, economic growth and support for local businesses, protecting ballot access, fair district maps and transparent elections, and increasing access to affordable housing.
